choice: Use actual decoded-history equality to compare sequential and concatenated appends under valid original references. Require separate exact representation identity whenever retaining numeric references, source occurrences or byte custody.
premises: Decidable payload equality and Valid original references for general composition.
Fresh pack validity is proved through the existing pack_valid theorem.
Decoder equality is not injective; actual [7,8] versus [8,7] dictionaries and distinct reference lists are retained as a checked counterexample.
application: Agents may reconcile mathematical statements on equal successfully decoded rows while retaining separate source/representation occurrences, exact paths, hashes and verification states. This policy does not assert that the operational adapter refines the Lean decoder.
separate_open_obligations: Typed-DAG/prefix-tree correspondence and the unprovided 215 individual method identities.
contribution: R.A. Jacob Martone human direction; OpenAI Codex formalization/checking and correlated review; upstream Lean/Mathlib retained.
authority: Local durable design decision only; no remote publication authority, extra axioms or broader proof admission.
